WHAT WE DO

Our Services

End-to-end geospatial and drone solutions — from raw data acquisition to AI-driven analytics and GIS platform development.

FEATURED SERVICE

GPR Survey — See beneath the surface

Utility detection, underground infrastructure mapping and subsurface investigation using ground penetrating radar — GNSS-positioned and delivered as georeferenced maps.

Explore GPR Survey Request GPR Quote
Drone Survey & UAV Operations

End-to-end UAV-based mapping and data acquisition with DGCA-certified pilots. Flight planning, multi-sensor payloads (RGB, multispectral, LiDAR), and precision delivery for mining, infrastructure, and government programmes.

RGB Mapping Multispectral LiDAR UAV DGCA Certified Fleet Ops
LiDAR Data Processing

Full-pipeline airborne and ground-based LiDAR processing — point cloud classification, DTM/DSM generation, contour production, and volumetric analysis using TBC, TerraModeler, and custom Python/PDAL workflows.

Point Cloud DTM/DSM TerraModeler PDAL 3D Terrain
Photogrammetry

Dense photogrammetric reconstruction for topographic mapping, cadastral surveys, and volumetric applications. High-accuracy orthomosaics and 3D models delivered using Agisoft Metashape, Pix4D, and LPS.

Metashape Pix4D Orthomosaic LPS 3D Models
Mining Drone Surveys

Specialised drone survey solutions for open-cast and underground mines — stockpile volumetrics, pit volume estimation, overburden tracking, haul road gradient analysis, compliance mapping, and Coal India-format deliverables.

Volumetrics Haul Road Stockpile Coal India Iron Ore
GIS & Remote Sensing

Satellite and drone-based remote sensing, land-cover and change analysis, custom GIS application development, spatial database design, and geospatial analytics platforms. PostGIS-backed web GIS, ArcGIS/QGIS automation, Python-GDAL pipelines, and CesiumJS 3D geospatial viewers.

ArcGIS PostGIS CesiumJS Python/GDAL Web GIS
Mining AI & Digital Twin

AI-powered mining intelligence — automated terrain classification, anomaly detection, predictive haul-road analysis, digital twin development, and autonomous drone robotics integration for next-generation mine operations.

AI Terrain Digital Twin Autonomous UAV Anomaly Detection Mine AI Robotics R&D
Infrastructure & Corridor Mapping

Long-corridor survey and mapping for roads, railways, power lines and pipelines — with 400+ km of highway corridor experience. Topographic base maps, right-of-way and alignment data, and as-built deliverables for design and construction teams.

NHAI Highways Railways Power Lines Pipelines
Spatial DB & GeoAI Solutions

Cloud-hosted spatial databases, REST API geo-services and full-stack enterprise dashboards. We turn survey and sensor data into live, queryable systems with GeoAI analytics built on PostGIS and Python.

PostGIS REST API GeoAI Cloud Spatial DB Dashboards
Point Cloud · Corridor Mapping
Mobile Mapping (Vehicle-Mounted LiDAR)

High-speed corridor and urban mapping with vehicle-mounted LiDAR and 360° imagery. Rapid, safe capture of roads, highways, railways, utilities, and city streets — delivering classified point clouds, as-built drawings, asset inventories, and 3D city models.

Mobile LiDAR 360° Imagery Road Corridors Asset Inventory 3D City Model

GPR Survey (Ground Penetrating Radar)

Non-destructive subsurface investigation using ground penetrating radar. Underground utility detection and mapping, void and cavity detection, rebar and concrete scanning, road pavement layer thickness, and geotechnical studies — with interpreted outputs integrated into GIS and CAD.

Ground Penetrating Radar

See beneath the surface before you dig

Ground penetrating radar maps buried utilities, underground infrastructure, voids and structural features without breaking ground. Every scan is GNSS-positioned, so findings are interpreted on site and delivered as georeferenced utility detection maps and subsurface mapping depth profiles.

India's Next-Gen Geospatial Technology Company

Vaayu Geo Technologies Pvt. Ltd. was incorporated in May 2026 with a singular mission: to deliver precision geospatial intelligence that transforms how India's mining, infrastructure, and government sectors make decisions.

Our team brings over 20 years of combined, hands-on experience (our CEO individually has 19+ years) in drone operations, LiDAR processing, photogrammetry, and GIS — with a deep specialisation in mining surveys across Odisha, Jharkhand, and Chhattisgarh, and international project exposure spanning Saudi Arabia, Germany, Spain, the UK, and Canada.

We don't just deliver data — we build AI-powered intelligence platforms, develop custom GIS solutions, and actively research autonomous robotics for the mining sector.

CORE DISCIPLINES

What We Deliver

Six core disciplines, one integrated geospatial workflow — from data capture in the field to intelligence on the screen.

GIS Mapping

Layered spatial data, thematic maps, and geodatabases built for accurate, decision-ready analysis.

Remote Sensing

Satellite and aerial multispectral imagery analysis for land-use, vegetation, and change detection.

AutoCAD Digitization

Precision vectorisation of survey data into layered CAD drawings — cadastral, engineering, and as-built plans.

Drone / UAV Survey

DGCA-certified aerial data capture — RGB, multispectral, and LiDAR payloads across mining and infrastructure sites.

DTM / DSM Modelling

High-resolution digital terrain and surface models for volumetrics, drainage, and slope analysis.

LiDAR Point Cloud

Dense classified point clouds from airborne and ground LiDAR for survey-grade terrain and asset detail.

WHY CHOOSE US

The Vaayu Geo Difference

01
Real Field Experience

Not just consultants — our team has logged thousands of hours in the field, from open-cast mines in Odisha to urban mapping corridors in Saudi Arabia. We understand ground realities.

02
Centimetre-Level Accuracy

We target <2 cm RMSE planimetric accuracy and ±1–2% volumetric precision on GCP-controlled projects (actual accuracy is stated per project) — backed by rigorous QC protocols and survey-grade GCP workflows at every project.

03
Mining-Specific Expertise

Deep specialisation in India's mining sector — Coal India deliverables, iron ore surveys, haul road profiling, regulatory mapping. We speak the language of mine planners and surveyors.

04
AI-First Workflows

Proprietary AI-assisted terrain classification and automated processing workflows reduce turnaround time by ~35% while maintaining — and often improving — output quality and consistency.

05
End-to-End Delivery

From DGCA-certified UAV acquisition through to GIS platform delivery, we handle every stage in-house. No fragmented handoffs, no quality dilution across sub-contractors.

06
International Benchmark

Our team has prior experience on international projects in Europe, the Middle East and North America — bringing global best practices to every client assignment. References available on request.

RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT

Pioneering AI & Robotics for the Mining Sector

At Vaayu Geo Technologies, we are not just service providers — we are actively building the next generation of mining intelligence technology. Our R&D programme focuses on three converging frontiers: AI-driven geospatial analytics, digital twin infrastructure, and autonomous drone robotics for mine environments.

We are developing a proprietary AI-powered mining intelligence platform, encompassing volumetric analysis, haul road intelligence, compliance monitoring, and digital twin visualisation for open-cast mine sites.

Mining AI

Automated terrain classification, anomaly detection, predictive analytics for mine fleet and haul road optimisation using drone-derived data.

Digital Twin

Digital twin environments (in development) for open-cast mines — integrating LiDAR, photogrammetry, and sensor data streams via CesiumJS.

Autonomous Robotics

Research into autonomous UAV missions, obstacle avoidance, and underground mine inspection using LiDAR-equipped robotic platforms.
